_readme: StandupTix venues harvested by scripts/fetch-events.js (source:
'standuptix'). StandupTix is an all-in-one ticketing+website platform
used by many comedy clubs; it has no public REST API (/api/events
returns 401) but every venue site exposes the same structured data:
1. GET {base_url}/site-maps/upcoming-events — an XML sitemap whose
<loc> entries are the venue's upcoming event pages.
2. Each event page embeds a schema.org ComedyEvent JSON-LD block
(<script type="application/ld+json">) with name, startDate (ISO
8601 with timezone offset), location+address, offers
(price/currency/availability/url), image, description, organizer.
To add a venue, append an entry here — the recipe is identical for any
StandupTix-powered club. Fields per venue:
name        — fallback venue name when the event JSON-LD carries no
location.name. Should match (or alias to) a venue in
config/venues.json.
base_url    — the venue site's origin, no trailing slash.
force_venue — OPTIONAL: pin every event from this site to one
canonical venue name, ignoring the per-event
location.name (same idea as the Eventbrite Conroe
organizer's forceVenue). Leave unset when the site may
list shows at more than one room — per-event
location.name + config/venues.json aliases then decide.
enabled     — per-venue kill switch.
Fetch etiquette: the platform's robots.txt sets Crawl-Delay: 3, so the
harvester sleeps ~3s between page fetches (~70 events ≈ 3.5 min per
venue). Keep the venue list short enough to fit the Action's timeout.

venues.name: The Riot Comedy Club
venues.note: The Riot's new Washington Ave home runs on StandupTix (moved off Eventbrite). Event JSON-LD names the location 'The Riot Houston', aliased to 'The Riot Comedy Club' in config/venues.json. No force_venue on purpose: if the site ever lists Conroe shows, their own location.name should win.
